thesis: TGTX is a stretched, news-spike entry in a hostile tape. The stock sits at an all-time high after a one-day gap on a modest sBLA acceptance (a convenience filing, not a new indication), trades above the mean analyst target, and carries rich multiples while sequential revenue growth is slowing. The regime is risk-off (VIX 99th percentile, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages), and a beta of 1.8 means a market bounce failure hits this name harder. Reward/risk is only about 1.6 from the entry zone, short interest is high, and post-spike fades are common. There is no edge in buying here, and the card's own advice is to wait for a pullback.
